Notes_and_Tips: Avoid old coconut and use fresh coconut only if needed for cooking.
Since work hours are late, keep the last meal light to support digestion and sleep.
Stress and late nights can increase cravings, so keep makhana or paneer ready instead of outside snacks.
For better physique improvement, make paneer and dal the main part of meals instead of extra rice.
Simple home style cooking will help maintain consistency even with irregular schedules.
